findings.title: Lazy locale loading ignores fallback locales, caching "translation missing" results
findings.body: I18n.translate only calls load_locale(config.locale) for the currently active locale, but with the new fallback chain [locale, SiteSetting.default_locale, :en] every lookup also consults the site default locale and :en. Those fallback locales are only pre-loaded by ApplicationController#set_locale's I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!, which runs exclusively for controller requests. Any translation performed outside a controller request (background jobs, mailers, serializers invoked from jobs, console/rake tasks) that sets I18n.locale directly will find the current locale loaded but the fallback locales empty, so the fallback chain resolves to a missing-translation value, and translate() then freezes that wrong value into the LRU_CACHE (translate_no_cache(key).freeze at line 75). The stale "translation missing" string keeps being served from cache even after the fallback locale is eventually loaded, until the entry is evicted or I18n.reload! runs. load_locale/translate should ensure the whole fallback chain (as returned by I18n.fallbacks[config.locale]) is loaded, not just config.locale.

findings.title: Translation cache key ignores the fallback chain, so changing default_locale serves stale translations
findings.body: The LRU cache key is built from only the translation key, config.locale, and the backend object id. With the new FallbackLocaleList, the value of I18n.t(key) for a given user locale now also depends on SiteSetting.default_locale (the middle entry of the fallback chain). If an admin changes SiteSetting.default_locale at runtime, the cache is not invalidated (nothing in this PR clears @cache on that setting change; it is only cleared by I18n.reload!), so translations that fell back to the old site default locale keep being served from the LRU cache even though the correct fallback is now the new locale. The cache key needs to incorporate the fallback chain (e.g. the joined list from I18n.fallbacks[locale]) or a default_locale change must flush the cache.

findings.title: No tests for the fallback behavior, and fallbacks are now enabled in dev/test where they previously were not
findings.body: This PR removes config.i18n.fallbacks = true from the production/profile/cloud66 environment files and instead enables the custom FallbackLocaleList globally, so development and test environments now have fallbacks for the first time. That silently masks missing translation keys during development and in the test suite (a missing key in a locale now falls back to the site locale/:en instead of surfacing "translation missing"), which is exactly how incomplete locale files will regress unnoticed. The PR also ships zero tests for the new behavior: nothing verifies the fallback order (user locale -> SiteSetting.default_locale -> :en), that ensure_loaded! preloads the chain, or that the translate accelerator cache interacts correctly with fallbacks. Add specs covering FallbackLocaleList#[] ordering and I18n.t fallback resolution, and consider keeping fallbacks disabled in the test environment so missing-key regressions still fail loudly.
